title: Cannabis.txt Licensing Record
description: Validates one record inside a Licensing: block, as defined in cannabis.txt section 8. Canonical keys only; `unknown`/`n/a` values normalize to null before validation.

id.description: Publisher-defined stable identifier for the license record, when assigned.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction that issued or administers the license.

license-holder.description: Legal entity or individual named on the license.

license-type.description: License category as named by the issuing authority.

license-number.description: Public license or file number, when published.

authority-id.description: Identifier linking the issuing authority to a licensing-authorities registry entry.

license-status.description: Status reported by the regulatory source.

license-status-detail.description: Regulator's exact wording when it does not map to the shared vocabulary.

source-url.description: Official regulatory record or lookup page.

last-verified.description: Date the information was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

location-id.description: Links the license to a Locations record.
